home.title: Gabriel Braga — Product & UX/UI Designer at Work & Co
home.description: Gabriel Braga (Hauser / Houser), Product, UX/UI & Interaction Designer at Work & Co in São Paulo. Case studies: Decolar, Aviva, São Paulo Metro, PlayStation Connect, Soundroom.

decolar.name: Decolar
decolar.title: Decolar — UX/UI Case Study | Gabriel Braga
decolar.description: Decolar design study by Gabriel Braga, Product & UX/UI Designer: a quiz-based flow that helps groups of friends align on a trip, with destination matches and a shared piggy bank.

aviva.name: Aviva
aviva.title: Aviva — E-commerce Design | Gabriel Braga
aviva.description: Aviva e-commerce by Gabriel Braga: the online store for Remanesce, the first collection of an independent Brazilian denim label, created for the Fashion Design thesis at Universidade Anhembi Morumbi.

metro.name: São Paulo Metro
metro.title: São Paulo Metro — Design Study | Gabriel Braga
metro.description: São Paulo Metro design study by Gabriel Braga: a mobility app concept that brings QR Code ticketing, top-ups, route planning on the metro map and live line status into one clean experience.

playstation.name: PlayStation Connect
playstation.title: PlayStation Connect — UX/UI Case Study | Gabriel Braga
playstation.description: PlayStation Connect design study by Gabriel Braga, Product & UX/UI Designer: a native PC launcher concept bringing PlayStation games, account continuity and subscription to PC gamers.

soundroom.name: Soundroom
soundroom.title: Soundroom — UX/UI Case Study | Gabriel Braga
soundroom.description: Soundroom, a university UX/UI project by Gabriel Braga: a social platform to log listening sessions, write entries, create playlists and discover independent artists.

about.name: About
about.title: About — Gabriel Braga, Designer
about.description: About Gabriel Braga, designer at Work & Co in São Paulo: background, experience (Work & Co, Cherey), Digital Design at Anhembi Morumbi, and a design philosophy built on intention, proportion and reduction.

albums.name: Favorite albums
albums.title: Favorite Albums — Gabriel Braga
albums.description: Albums Gabriel Braga keeps coming back to, from Pink Floyd and The Beatles to Radiohead, Tame Impala and Porter Robinson — browsed as 3D vinyl records.

films.name: Favorite films, series and anime
films.title: Screen: Favorite Films, Series & Anime — Gabriel Braga
films.description: Films, series and anime Gabriel Braga loves, from Perfect Days, Parasite and Ainda Estou Aqui to Breaking Bad, Frieren and Akira — browsed as 3D discs, each credited to its creators.

books.name: Favorite books
books.title: Favorite Books — Gabriel Braga
books.description: Books that shaped how Gabriel Braga thinks about design, by Don Norman, Paul Rand, Massimo Vignelli, Ellen Lupton and more — browsed as 3D books.
